data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental with no license in 2031? You don't need a permit – every charter in our fleet includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, and go up to €4,719 for 4 hours on the Mangusta 80 (jet ski included). With 17 boats departing from Puerto Banús, you can explore the Costa del Sol without a licence.

Why choose a no-license boat rental in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline is best seen from the water, but not everyone holds a boating licence. Our skippered charters solve that: you get a professional captain who knows the local waters, moorings, and weather. You can focus on swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying the views of La Concha mountain and the Golden Mile. All prices include skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish VAT (21%) – no surprises.

2025 no-license boat rental prices in Marbella

We offer two pricing tiers for transparent booking:

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749/2h, €1,149/4h, €1,699/6h, €2,299/8h. Includes skipper, drinks, snacks, fuel, IVA.
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80 – white or grey): €4,719 minimum 4 hours. Includes a free jet ski. Skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, IVA all included.
  • Other boats (e.g., Ferretti 94, Maiora 26m, Pershing 46, Lagoon 380, speedboat): pricing on request via WhatsApp.

Where can you go without a license?

Your skipper knows the best spots. Popular destinations from Puerto Banús include:

  • Cabopino – quiet coves and a sandbar, 20 minutes east.
  • Cala del Faro – rocky cliffs for snorkelling, 15 minutes west.
  • Cala Cortés – secluded beach, 30 minutes west.
  • Estepona – marina and old town, 25 minutes west.
  • Sotogrande – luxury marina, 45 minutes west.

Your skipper can adjust the route based on sea conditions and your preferences.

How to book your no-license boat in Marbella

For Tier A and B boats, you can book directly online or via WhatsApp. For all other boats, contact us on WhatsApp for availability and exact pricing. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially in summer.
